display.purpose: Rare accent phrases only — one per screen.

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: Default and only shadow for .card surfaces.

shadows.name: sticky-lift
shadows.purpose: Mobile bottom sticky action bar only, paired with a 10px backdrop blur.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action button (Add to Cart, Pay with Paystack, Checkout).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--color-choc, #2B140F); color: var(--color-white, #FFFDF8); border: none; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; padding: 14px 28px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, opacity 0.2s, transform 0.12s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-cocoa, #684234); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.99); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-choc, #2B140F); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-choc, #2B140F); border: 1.5px solid var(--color-choc, #2B140F); border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; padding: 14px 28px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-choc, #2B140F); color: var(--color-white, #FFFDF8); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-choc, #2B140F); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Default elevated surface for products, order summaries, admin panels.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-white, #FFFDF8); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(50,26,23,0.08); padding: 18px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--color-choc, #2B140F); margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-text-muted, #5c443f); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text/email/tel field used across checkout, account, and admin forms.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--color-cream, #F5EBD6); border: 1.5px solid rgba(50,26,23,0.15); border-radius: 8px; padding: 13px 16px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-choc, #2B140F); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-choc, #2B140F); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(50,26,23,0.08); }

components.name: WhatsApp Button
components.description: The one intentional palette exception — always opens a real WhatsApp chat.
components.css: .ds-btn-whatsapp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #25D366; color: #FFFDF8; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; padding: 14px 28px; text-decoration: none; }

narrative.overview: Aries 11 Bakehouse reads like the counter of a real neighborhood bakery, not a generic e-commerce template: a deep-chocolate-and-cream palette, fully pill-shaped buttons and inputs, and a single soft ambient shadow doing all the "lift" the interface needs. It is confident without being loud — no gradients, no heavy drop shadows, no corporate blue. An italic serif (Cormorant Garamond) appears only on select display phrases as a handwritten-menu-board accent against an otherwise all-sans (DM Sans) interface; that contrast is the system's one deliberate flourish. The system is nearly flat by design: cards rest on a bare cream background with barely-there shadows, and depth is implied by spacing and color contrast rather than elevation.
keyCharacteristics: Deep chocolate + cream as the whole palette; caramel and olive as the only accents
Pill-shaped buttons and inputs everywhere — no sharp-cornered interactive elements
One soft ambient card shadow; otherwise flat
Serif italic (Cormorant Garamond) reserved for display moments; DM Sans for everything else
WhatsApp green is the one color intentionally borrowed from outside the palette

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Every color on the site is either chocolate/cocoa/cream/caramel/olive or the single, deliberate WhatsApp green exception. No blue, no purple, no generic UI gray.

rules.name: The One Flourish Rule
rules.body: Cormorant Garamond italic appears on at most one phrase per screen.

rules.name: The Whisper-Lift Rule
rules.body: No card or panel gets more shadow than the single ambient token. If something needs to feel more important, raise its content weight or spacing — never stack a second shadow tier.

dos: Do keep every button, input, select, and textarea fully pill-shaped or 8px-radius on cards — never introduce a third radius value.
Do keep Cormorant Garamond italic rare — one display moment per screen.
Do keep the WhatsApp button's green as the only non-palette color anywhere in the UI.
Do use the single ambient card shadow for any new elevated surface.
donts: Don't introduce blue, purple, or neutral gray as an accent.
Don't add a second serif/display font family.
Don't give any interactive element a sharp (non-pill, non-8px) corner.
Don't stack multiple shadow tiers or add a drop shadow to text.
